name: @nodegx/node-spec
description: Each NodeGX node's behaviour written once, as an executable spec (pure reducers), plus the interpreter that runs a spec as a node and records a JSON trace. Phase 107 (NSP-001). No dependency on the runtime, the editor or React — everything that needs a node's behaviour imports this.
author: The Low Code Foundation <contact@thelowcodefoundation.com>
